name: M. Joseph Medical
old_description: Injured workers pay no out-of-pocket expenses through our national network of pharmacies & mail-order channels.
about:
M. Joseph Medical was founded in 1985 in Louisville, Kentucky, as a durable medical equipment supplier to the workers' compensation payer community. The company has operated as an employee-owned business since its inception, a structure it credits for steady, controllable growth without the mergers, acquisitions, or high turnover that have affected competitors.

Today the firm provides pharmacy benefit management (PBM) and durable medical equipment (DME) services on a national scale. Its pharmacy solutions include a nationwide network of retail and mail-order pharmacies that allow injured workers to fill prescriptions with no out-of-pocket expense. Ancillary offerings span disposable medical products, translation and transportation services, home health care, electrotherapy, and catastrophic claim support. The company also issues first-fill and Rx cards to streamline medication access.

The primary customers are workers' compensation payers — insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and self-insured employers — who rely on M. Joseph Medical to manage pharmacy and ancillary benefits for injured workers. The company also serves a national network of pharmacies that participate in its mail-order and retail channels.

Leadership says the employee-ownership model aligns incentives toward long-term service quality rather than short-term financial engineering. By avoiding external ownership changes, the firm maintains consistent staffing and institutional knowledge, which it says translates into higher care standards and competitive pricing for its payer clients.
